# Getting help

The resources below explain how to get assistance with Tellurian nix-terminal
depending on the type of question you have.

## Start here

- Review [`README.md`](../README.md) for setup instructions and project goals.
- Search existing issues, pull requests, and discussions to avoid duplicates.
- Check the commit history for recent changes that might affect your topic.

## Ask a question

- **How-to / design questions** – Start a thread in
  [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/tellurian/nix-terminal/discussions) or
  open a feature request issue describing the workflow you are trying to unlock.
- **Bug reports** – Use the bug report issue template and include OS, Rust
  version (`rustc --version`), and reproduction steps.
- **Security concerns** – Follow [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) for the private
  reporting process.

## Contribution support

If you are working on a pull request and need help, provide links to the branch
and describe what you have tried so far. Review the guidance in
[`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) prior to requesting maintainer time.

## Sponsorship and roadmap

Sponsorship opportunities are documented in [`FUNDING.yml`](FUNDING.yml). Reach
out if you would like to prioritize a feature or help fund long-term support.
